title: 第19章 告别樱花镇第20章 好歹风光过
slug: 重生后为当他的皇后杀疯了
content_zh:
太子殿下说，今日就带她出发去往皇城，准备进宫？
樱落的心“咚咚”跳得很快。
当真没想到，事情居然如此顺利。
她只不过展示了一点点的巫术，竟让两位殿下如此的相信，这当真是一个好的开头。
“对了，本王不得不提醒你，皇宫中有皇宫的规矩，所以这次只能你一人入宫，你这妹妹，怕是不能同去……”齐煜突然说道。
“樱落多谢殿下的提醒，宫中的规矩，樱落一切都明白。”
嘴上虽这么说着，樱落心里却在吐槽：
这个五皇子怎么这么冷血呢！
她已经被认定为天女，按理来说带个小丫头进宫，也无伤大雅，没想到齐煜一句话就断了后路。
“明白就好，那你准备一下，一会就跟我和皇兄上马车吧。”
齐煜说完，指了指不远处樱花林中的马队，已经蓄势待发。
原来一切都准备好了。
“等等，再等等，花婆婆和胡爷爷还没有来，他们看不见我会伤心的……”
樱落说着，一双星眸有些焦急的望着竹屋的方向。
没想到今日，便是樱落在樱花镇待的最后一天，她还没有来得及和亲人告别呢。
“时间不早了，我们得尽快出发，趁天黑前赶到下一个住宿。”
齐煜冷冷的催促着，毕竟皇城路途遥远，不可耽误。
樱落哀怨的瞪了齐煜一眼，这让齐煜很不舒服。
这女人胆子可是越来越大了，居然用这种眼神看着自己。
“五弟，让樱落姑娘和亲人告个别吧！”

齐瀚望向远方，幽幽的说：“这一去，就不知何时才能回来了，樱落姑娘不舍，也是人之常情。”
樱落心里一阵感动，果然还是齐瀚对她好。
而齐煜每次冷冰冰的样子，真是令人讨厌！
“樱落多谢太子殿下和五皇子成全。”
说完，齐瀚和齐煜一行人便先行离开，上了马车，只留下了樱落和星儿还在原地发着呆。
“姐姐，你一会就要走了吗？”
星儿有些慌乱，她还没有准备好给姐姐送行呢，怎么姐姐就要进宫了呀。
想着便哭了起来，眼泪止不住的往外流。
从小到大，她们姐妹俩相依为命，若不是有胡爷爷和花婆婆的帮助，怕是樱落和星儿早就流落在外饿死了。
但其实，星儿并非是樱落的亲妹妹，而是被樱落在落花河中所救。
樱落见她同自己一样无依无靠，便好心收留了她，从此二人便以姐妹相称，樱落对这个妹妹十分的疼爱。
星儿心思单纯，对樱落也是忠心耿耿，姐姐说什么那便是什么。
因为她知道，若不是姐姐救下了自己，怕是当时早就死在了那乱世之中，怎可还有今日的时光。
“好啦，星儿乖，等姐姐安顿好了，便会回来接上星儿一起进宫，到时候我们姐妹俩又可以在一起了。”
樱落安慰着星儿，她知道星儿舍不得自己，自己又何尝不是一样的心情？……
“好，姐姐可要说话算数！若是姐姐忘记了星儿，那么星儿一辈子都不要理姐姐了！”
星儿嘴上这样说着，但心里怎么想的，她自己是知道的。
content_en:
His Highness the Crown Prince said that he would take her to the imperial city today to prepare for entering the palace?
Ying Luo's heart was beating very fast.
I really didn't expect that things would go so smoothly.
She only showed a little bit of witchcraft and actually made the two highnesses believe in her. This was really a good start.
"By the way, I have to remind you that there are royal rules in the palace, so you can only enter the palace alone this time. I'm afraid you, my sister, can't go with you..." Qi Yu suddenly said.
"Yingluo, thank you for your highness's reminder. Yingluo understands all the rules in the palace."
Although she said this, Yingluo was complaining in her heart:
Why is this fifth prince so cold-blooded!
She has been recognized as a goddess, so it would be okay to bring a little girl into the palace, but she didn't expect that Qi Yu's escape would be cut off with just one word.
"As long as you understand, then get ready and get on the carriage with me and the emperor in a moment."
After Qi Yu finished speaking, he pointed to the cavalry in the cherry blossom forest not far away, ready to go.
It turns out everything is ready.
"Wait, wait, Granny Hua and Grandpa Hu haven't come yet. They will be sad if they can't see me..."
Yingluo said, her starry eyes looking anxiously in the direction of the bamboo house.
Unexpectedly, today would be Yingluo's last day in Sakura Town, and she hadn't had time to say goodbye to her relatives yet.
"It's getting late, we have to leave as soon as possible and get to the next accommodation before dark."
Qi Yu urged coldly, after all, the imperial city is a long way away and cannot be delayed.
Yingluo glared at Qi Yu sadly, which made Qi Yu very uncomfortable.
This woman is getting bolder and bolder, and she actually looks at herself like this.
"Fifth brother, let Miss Yingluo say goodbye to her relatives!"
Qi Han looked into the distance and said quietly: "Once I leave, I don't know when I will come back. It's human nature for Miss Yingluo to be reluctant to leave."
Yingluo felt moved in her heart, and Qi Han was indeed kind to her.
And Qi Yu's cold look every time is really annoying!
"Ying Luo thanks His Royal Highness the Crown Prince and the Fifth Prince for their support."
After saying that, Qi Han, Qi Yu and his group left first and got on the carriage, leaving only Ying Luo and Xing'er still in a daze.
"Sister, are you leaving soon?"
Xing'er was a little flustered. She was not ready to see her sister off yet. Why was her sister about to enter the palace?
I started crying just thinking about it, and my tears couldn't stop flowing out.
Growing up, the two sisters had depended on each other. If it hadn't been for the help of Grandpa Hu and Grandma Hua, Yingluo and Xing'er would have been left out and starved to death.
But in fact, Xing'er is not Yingluo's biological sister, but was rescued by Yingluo in the Luohua River.
Yingluo saw that she was as helpless as herself, so she kindly took her in. From then on, the two became like sisters, and Yingluo loved this sister very much.
Xing'er is simple-minded and loyal to Yingluo. Whatever her sister says is what she says.
Because she knew that if her sister hadn't saved her, she would have died in the troubled times, and how could she still be alive today.
"Okay, Xing'er, be good. When sister settles down, she will come back to pick up Xing'er and bring her into the palace. Then we sisters can be together again."
Yingluo comforted Xing'er. She knew that Xing'er couldn't let her go, so why didn't she feel the same way? …
"Okay, sister must keep her word! If sister forgets Xing'er, then Xing'er will ignore her for the rest of her life!"
Xing'er said this, but she knew what she was thinking in her heart.
